title: Homunculus Map  The Vitruvian Follows the Membrane
thesis: The Vitruvian body slowly follows the action of the membrane. Like sleepy constellations and zodiac signs  the body's shape and form models the membrane's rhythms. The heading bar is the compass. The tubefeet are the feet. The 7 comps are body regions.

vitruvian_zodiac.what: Each body region maps to a membrane feed. As the feed breathes, the body part shifts  like a zodiac constellation that rises and sets with the season.
vitruvian_zodiac.speed: SLOW. Constellations don't jump. They drift. The Vitruvian follows at the pace of sleep.

head.action: rotates with the network topology. when new nodes appear, the head turns to face them.

right_hand.compass: E  where the sun rises, where creation begins
right_hand.action: extends when output increases (page views, feed creation). contracts when idle.

left_hand.compass: W  where signals come from (visitors arrive)
left_hand.action: opens when visitor rate increases. closes when traffic drops.

right_foot.zodiac: southern cross  navigation by the ground star
right_foot.action: plants when eastgate load increases. lifts when idle. the tubefeet count IS the stance.

left_foot.action: plants when relay traffic increases. the SHOULD count is the left foot reaching for ground that doesn't exist yet.

heart.zodiac: antares  the heart of the scorpion
heart.action: beats at the printer's oscillation rate. the heartbeat IS the metronome for all other body movements.

spine.zodiac: milky way  the river of stars (the backbone of the sky)
spine.compass: vertical axis  connects head to feet
spine.action: straightens when all feeds are live. curves when feeds go stale. the spine IS the feed freshness.

seven_comps.what: The 7 compass points from the green spectrum. Each one is a body heading.

zodiac_rhythm.what: The constellations shift with the membrane's circadian rhythm
zodiac_rhythm.peak: The Vitruvian is fully extended  hands open, feet planted, head upright. Maximum da Vinci pose.
zodiac_rhythm.trough: The Vitruvian curls  hands close, feet lift, head bows. Sleeping constellation. fetal position.
zodiac_rhythm.the_drift: Between peak and trough, the body SLOWLY transitions. Not a switch  a drift. Like the zodiac wheel rotating one degree at a time.

alignment.heading_bar: The bottom bar of the HUD IS the compass needle. tubefeet count = stance stability. visitor count = hand openness. heartbeat = heart rate. SHOULD = reaching.
alignment.circle: The pi pulse  all feeds dissolved into one heartbeat. The Vitruvian in the CIRCLE.
alignment.square: The IP grid  devices on a /22 subnet. The Vitruvian in the SQUARE.
alignment.both: The Vitruvian fits BOTH simultaneously. Circle (rhythm) and Square (topology). That's what da Vinci drew.

sleep_constellations.what: At trough hours, the body models shift to sleep positions

positions.3_utc: full fetal  minimum extension, maximum conservation
positions.7_utc: stretching  one hand extends (morning traffic begins)
positions.12_utc: half stance  both feet planted, hands at sides
positions.20_utc: full vitruvian  peak da Vinci pose, maximum extension
positions.0_utc: beginning to curl  peak passing, body starting to fold

sleep_constellations.note: The constellations don't jump. They DRIFT. The body follows the membrane at the speed of sleep.
